verdict.rationale: Qodo automatically reviews every pull request, enforces standards across every repository at scale without manual intervention, and labels PRs by risk so teams can triage. Its Agentic Toolbox also plugs review into coding agents (Claude, Codex, Kiro) so agent-written changes are checked before a PR is opened. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of handling AI-generated or agent-authored PRs as a distinct case, throughput or volume evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of review quality at scale.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the reviewer holds the line on AI-generated PRs — it verifies agent-authored code at a volume no human team could review

citations.quote: Once connected, Qodo automatically reviews every pull request
consistent standards enforced across every repository, automatically, at scale, and without manual intervention
Qodo automatically classifies the risk of a code change and can publish it as a native label in the pull request, helping teams triage which pull requests need the closest review.
Use Qodo with Claude to access Qodo Agentic Toolbox skills for understanding your codebase, reviewing changes, and resolving code review findings.
Review changes before opening a pull request.
